-- iface/check.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package iface

type Worker interface { Work() int }

//logos:zeroalloc
func Check(w Worker) int { return w.Work() }

package param

//logos:zeroalloc
func Check(f func() int) int { return f() }

package field

type Worker struct { Work func() int }

//logos:zeroalloc
func Check(w Worker) int { return w.Work() }

-- reassigned/check.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package reassigned

func plain() int { return 1 }

//logos:zeroalloc
func Check() int {
 f := func() int { return 2 }
 f = plain
 return f()
}

-- chain/check.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package chain

//logos:zeroalloc
func Check(n int) []byte { return middle(n) }

//go:noinline
func middle(n int) []byte { return last(n) }

//go:noinline
func last(n int) []byte { return make([]byte, n) }

// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package literal

//logos:zeroalloc
func Check() int {
 f := func() int { return 7 }
 return f()
}

-- valueexpr/check.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package valueexpr

type Worker struct{}

//go:noinline
func (Worker) Work(n int) []byte { return make([]byte, n) }

//logos:zeroalloc
func Check(w Worker, n int) []byte { return Worker.Work(w, n) }

-- ptrexpr/check.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package ptrexpr

type Worker struct{}

//go:noinline
func (*Worker) Work(n int) []byte { return make([]byte, n) }

//logos:zeroalloc
func Check(w *Worker, n int) []byte { return (*Worker).Work(w, n) }

-- ifaceexpr/check.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package ifaceexpr

type Worker interface { Work() int }

//logos:zeroalloc
func Check(w Worker) int { return Worker.Work(w) }

-- plainexpr/check.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package plainexpr

type Worker struct { N int }

//go:noinline
func (w Worker) Value() int { return w.N }

//go:noinline
func (w *Worker) Pointer() int { return w.N }

//logos:zeroalloc
func CheckValue(w Worker) int { return Worker.Value(w) }

//logos:zeroalloc
func CheckPointer(w *Worker) int { return (*Worker).Pointer(w) }
